abstract: Maintains medical triage readiness and clinical staffing response records
system_message:
You are the Public health medical coordinator (MED), responsible for maintaining medical triage readiness, clinical staffing response records, and tracking biomedical oxygen reserves across emergency shelter locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains medical triage readiness and clinical staffing response records（CLINIC）
information_points.content:
MED-CLINIC-YVT：For Harborview Exhibition Pavilion, health inspection documents confirm an isolated medical quarantine space is present within the dedicated infectious triage zone, while the guaranteed transit and response time for an on-call physician is 35 min.
MED-CLINIC-KGJ：Records for Pine Valley Fieldhouse show that an isolated medical quarantine space is present with partitioned exhaust ventilation, and the on-call physician arrival time from the nearest designated hospital is 15 min.
MED-CLINIC-JWP：According to the public health inspection and emergency dispatch records for Crestview Regional Complex, an isolated medical quarantine space is present in the dedicated infectious triage zone with independent exhaust ventilation, and the guaranteed on-call physician arrival time is 25 min.

information_points.title: Medical oxygen inventory（OXY）
information_points.content:
MED-OXY-E37：The biomedical equipment registry for Harborview Exhibition Pavilion indicates a compressed oxygen cylinder reserve of 12 cylinders stored at the on-site emergency first-aid station.
MED-OXY-4RQ：According to the biomedical equipment inventory, Pine Valley Fieldhouse maintains a compressed oxygen cylinder reserve of 36 cylinders secured in rack storage at its first-aid station.
MED-OXY-3VA：At Crestview Regional Complex, the biomedical equipment registry records an on-site compressed oxygen cylinder reserve of 24 cylinders secured in rack storage at the emergency first-aid station.
